prompt:
You are watching a volleyball match from a fixed camera.

This clip begins at {start:.2f} seconds into the match.

List every time a player touches the ball. For each touch give:
  t       - the time of contact in absolute match seconds
  type    - serve, receive, dig, set, attack, kill or block
  side    - "left" or "right": which half of the frame the player is standing in
  number  - the player's jersey number as a string, or null if you cannot read it
  error   - true if the touch was a mistake
  point   - true if the rally ended here and a point was scored
